assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness that have significantly impacted daily activities.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms.
The service corresponds to CPT code 93226.
The service is a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The service was performed in conjunction with diagnoses R55 and R42.
